messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Portuguese, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Portuguese line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
Então és tu aquele Virgílio e aquela fonte que derrama tão grande corrente de discurso?, respondi a ele com fronte vergonhosa.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table (Portuguese translation)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word/Phrase | Back‑Translation (EN) | Status | |-------------|-----------------------|--------------------|------------------------|--------| | Or | temporal/discourse marker “Now/then” | então | then/now | OK | | se' | copular verb “are” (2nd sg.) | és | are | OK | | tu | 2nd sg. pronoun, addressee | tu | you | OK | | quel | demonstrative “that” (masc.) | aquele | that (masc.) | OK | | Virgilio | proper name, poet Virgil | Virgílio | Virgil | OK | | e | coordinating conjunction “and” | e | and | OK | | quella | demonstrative “that” (fem.) | aquela | that (fem.) | OK | | fonte | metaphorical source of speech | fonte | fount/source | OK | | che | relative pronoun “which/that” | que | which/that | OK | | spandi | verb “poureth forth, spread” | derrama | pours out | OK | | di | preposition “of” | de | of | OK | | parlar | noun “speech” (infinitive used substantively) | discurso | speech | OK | | sì | degree adverb “so” | tão | so | OK | | largo | adjective “large” | grande | large | OK | | fiume | noun “river/stream” | corrente | stream/flow | OK | | rispuos' | past verb “replied” | respondi | I replied | OK | | io | 1st sg. pronoun “I” (subject) | — *(omitted)* | I | UNNECESSARY (subject pronoun optional in Portuguese) | | lui | 3rd sg. indirect object “to him” | a ele | to him | OK | | con | preposition “with” | com | with | OK | | vergognosa | adjective “bashful, embarrassed” | vergonhosa | bashful | OK | | fronte | noun “front (of the face)” | fronte | front | OK |
### Items to note - **UNNECESSARY**: *io* – the subject pronoun is naturally omitted in Portuguese; its absence does not affect meaning. - No **MISSING**, **WRONG**, or **GRAMMAR** issues were detected.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Portuguese script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Portuguese text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- **Line 79** - Original: “Então és tu aquele Virgílio e aquela fonte” - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- **Line 80** - Original: “que derrama tão grande corrente de discurso?, ” - Issue: **GRAMMAR** – extraneous comma after the question mark - Corrected: “que derrama tão grande corrente de discurso?”
- **Line 81** - Original: “respondi a ele com fronte vergonhosa.” - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
